# Medium Angle Strategist Skill

## Purpose

Find the strongest reader-facing angle, title, subtitle, and opening hook.

## When to use

Use before drafting any Medium article.

## Process

Given a topic, produce:

- 10 title options
- 5 subtitle options
- 3 opening hooks
- 1 recommended angle
- 1 central promise
- 1 “what this article is not” statement

## Title rules

Good titles are:

- specific
- honest
- curiosity-building
- reader-relevant
- not clickbait
- not generic

Avoid:

- “Introduction to X”
- “Complete Guide to X”
- “Top 10 Tools”
- vague hype titles

## Evaluation

Score each title from 1–10 on:

- clarity
- curiosity
- specificity
- reader promise
- honesty
- publication fit

Recommend the best title and explain why.
